# mpware

Run `mpware.exe` from this folder. The executable launches the patched PowerShell runtime in `_FOLDERMUSTBEONCDRIVE`, so keep the folder structure together when moving or uploading it.

Recommended install/use:
1. Extract the zip.
2. Right-click `mpware.exe`.
3. Choose **Run as administrator**.

See `NOTICE.md` for package notes and blocked paths.
